tldr: Venus in the 4th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward home, family, and roots
body: Venus in the 4th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward home, family, and roots. Gift: ease and charm there. Watch: indulgence or avoidance. With Venus in the 4th house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. This makes what makes you feel rooted, protected, and emotionally held a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through home and roots.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in home and roots.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
